usedFor: Clientjoy captures leads and customers, and HubSpot receives each as a deal through “Create Deal”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Lead Is Added” in Clientjoy, then “Create Deal” in HubSpot
bestTemplate.why: Every new lead gets its own deal in HubSpot the moment it is added.

watchOut: “Lead Is Updated” also reaches “Create Deal”, so that trigger would open another deal for the same lead.
